business.name: King Equipment
business.tagline: Equipment rental & sales for Toronto, Markham & Durham Region — delivered.
business.shortDescription: Local equipment rental and sales — serving Toronto, Markham, and the Durham Region (Pickering, Ajax, Whitby, Oshawa, Uxbridge, Clarington, Scugog, Brock). Construction heaters, drying and water damage equipment, inverter generators, and more. Daily, weekly, and monthly rental rates, with select used equipment for sale. Delivery across the service area.

pricing.deliveryNote: Delivery across Toronto, Markham, and the Durham Region. Delivery pricing varies by city — see each equipment page for a quote.
pricing.multiDayNote: Weekly rate kicks in automatically once it's cheaper than per-day. Monthly rate kicks in automatically once it's cheaper than per-week.
pricing.comparisonNote: Owner-operated. Honest pricing. Clean, well-maintained equipment.

trustPoints: Local owner-operator — not a national chain
Transparent pricing — daily, weekly, and monthly rates visible on every item
Automatic rate tiering — you always get the cheapest applicable rate
Delivery across Toronto, Markham, and Durham Region
Used equipment also available for sale

faq.a: Every item has a daily, weekly, and monthly rate. We automatically charge whichever is cheapest for your rental length. If 5 days at the daily rate costs more than our weekly rate, you pay the weekly rate — so 5–7 days always costs the weekly amount. Same rule applies at the monthly tier.

faq.q: Can I rent multiple items in one order?
faq.a: Yes — add everything you need to your cart and check out in one go. One delivery, one deposit, one pickup.
Each item has a deposit shown on its page. Deposit is returned on pickup once equipment is confirmed in working condition.

faq.q: Which cities do you deliver to?
faq.a: Toronto, Markham, Pickering, Ajax, Whitby, Oshawa, Uxbridge, Clarington, Scugog, and Brock. Delivery price shows on every equipment page by city.

faq.q: Can I buy equipment instead of renting?
faq.a: Yes — we have a Buy section featuring select used equipment. Prices and condition shown on each listing.

faq.q: How do I pick up or arrange delivery?
faq.a: Once you place a rental, we'll confirm delivery time within a few hours during business hours. We handle drop-off and pickup within the service area.
